sections.description: A named group-by attribute of the entity that declares it (FR-044). Groups report rows by a column value as-is. @of names Entity.field: the owning entity, or the @via terminal. @via may follow only to-one hops, so grouping by a related row's column can never multiply the measured rows.
sections.whenToUse: A column a dashboard groups by: product, status, region. Declare it once on the fact entity and reference it by name from reports.

attrs.name: of
attrs.description: Dotted Entity.field reference naming the grouped column (e.g. 'Purchase.programId', or 'Program.title' with @via). Entity.field.member names a member of a value object stored with @storage: flattened (e.g. 'Payment.amount.currency'), which has a column of its own.

attrs.name: via
attrs.description: Optional dotted to-one relationship path from the owning entity to the entity @of names (e.g. 'Purchase.program'). Every hop must be @cardinality: one or an identity.reference.

sections.description: A named time dimension (FR-044): groups report rows by a date or timestamp column truncated to a grain. @of names a field.date or field.timestamp. Weeks start on Monday (ISO-8601) in every lowering. A report names it as 'dimension:grain' and the derived report field is <dimension><Grain> (e.g. purchasedAtDay).
sections.whenToUse: Per-day, per-week or per-month series on a dashboard.

attrs.name: grains
attrs.description: The grains this dimension supports. Weeks start Monday (ISO-8601). 'hour' is refused on a field.date.

attrs.name: of
attrs.description: Dotted Entity.field reference naming the date or timestamp column, or Entity.field.member for a member of a flattened value object.

attrs.name: via
attrs.description: Optional dotted to-one relationship path, as on dimension.attribute.
